decision_table.name: Determine_MI_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Michigan state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in Michigan (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Michigan filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: MCL 206.621 (Nexus requirements) Reference: MI Form 4567 Instructions

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Michigan filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts or 200 transactions.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: Michigan Department of Treasury Revenue Administrative Bulletin 2018-16
No Michigan nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MI_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Michigan state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Michigan state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A deduction addback - Bonus depreciation (partial decoupling)
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Michigan municipal bonds - Michigan-specific NOL deduction
Reference: MI Form 4567 Instructions Reference: MCL 206.623 (Adjustments to federal taxable income)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MI_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Michigan state corporate income tax. Applies 6% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Michigan state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Michigan: × [Apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Additions] 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions] 5. Michigan taxable income: = [Result] 6. Michigan tax rate: × 6.0% 7. Michigan income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Michigan credits: - [Credits] 9. Michigan tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: MI Form 4567 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: MCL 206.623 (Tax rate: 6%) Reference: Michigan Department of Treasury Corporate Income Tax Guide
No Michigan nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Michigan taxable income - no tax liability. Michigan NOL rules may apply (not implemented).
